title: Controls › Keys: the API keys Jarvis holds, write-only (GET /api/keys)
description: Contract set v2 addition (core wave 1, K1; JARVIS_CORE_BUILD_MAP §3). A key is never sent back: rows carry at most its last 4 characters. Routes (all on the core, loopback or tailnet only, hub session token in X-Jarvis-Session): GET /api/keys → this document · POST /api/keys/{id}/next with $defs/next_request → $defs/row (stored as next and checked; never made live by itself) · POST /api/keys/{id}/promote → $defs/row (next becomes live, the old live key is kept as previous for 15 minutes) · DELETE /api/keys/{id}/previous → $defs/row · DELETE /api/keys/{id} with $defs/remove_request → $defs/row (every slot removed, status missing). Errors → $defs/error. Live updates: the event keys.updated with $defs/updated. Activity: an activity.added receipt per change (category keys) whose words come from $defs/audit, never key material.

can_write.description: False on a view-only device (the phone): the page shows the rows and accepts nothing.

rows.description: One row per service, in display order. The four default services (Claude, ElevenLabs, Composio, the restic backup password) always have a row (status missing until a key is added); an optional service (Google OAuth client, OpenWeather, …) has a row once a key was added for it.

addable.description: Optional services that can be added from the "Add a service" list (Google OAuth client, OpenWeather, …) and have no row yet.

audit.description: The latest changes, newest first (at most 20).

provider_id.description: A service id: anthropic, elevenlabs, composio, google-oauth, restic, openweather, …

kind.description: token: one pasted API key. client_json: Google's OAuth client file (paste or drop the JSON). password: a password with no remote check (restic).

checkable.description: False when there is no remote check (restic): the key is only checked for shape.

console_url.description: The provider's page where he creates and revokes keys (Jarvis can't revoke keys itself).

status.description: Live · Next waiting (a checked key is ready to make live) · Checking · Failed check · Missing (no live key) · Expiring (Google refresh token running out) · Fell back (the new key was refused within 15 minutes, so Jarvis went back to the previous one: flag it on the page and in Your yes).

check.description: The last check of one slot. shape_only: no remote check exists, the shape was fine.

reason.description: Why a check failed, as a fixed code (the provider's own error text is never passed on: it can echo key material). rejected: 401 · forbidden: 403 · bad_shape: not what this service's key looks like · rate_limited: 429 · unreachable: no answer (network) · provider_error: 5xx or anything else · refresh_failed: Google refused the refresh token · too_long: too big for Credential Manager · refused_after_swap: it worked in the check but was refused once live.

last4.description: The key's last 4 characters (for Google, of the client secret). null for a password: nothing of it is shown.

until.description: previous only: when it is removed automatically (15 minutes after the swap).

expires.description: When the credential runs out, when the provider says (Google refresh token).

detail.description: One plain sentence for the row when the status needs it (never key material).

used.description: When Jarvis last used the live key ("Used 12 s ago").

secret.description: The pasted key (or the Google client JSON as text). Sent once; the page clears the field at once and never keeps it.

confirm.description: Must equal the id in the path: proof he meant this service.

row.description: The row as it stands, when there is one.

error.description: HTTP 404 unknown_provider · 409 no_next / next_not_checked / no_previous · 400 confirm_required / bad_request · 403 not_allowed (not loopback or tailnet, or no valid hub session) / view_only · 503 store_unavailable (Credential Manager can't be reached).

text.description: The Activity line, e.g. "Claude key replaced". Never key material.

updated.description: data of the keys.updated event: the changed row, and the audit entry when the change was one.
